s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss in one eye with retinal abnormalities
salient_findings: Visual loss in the left eye
Ischemic macular whitening in the left eye
Abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula
key_facts: 2-day history of visual loss in the left eye
No dehydration or other precipitating factors noted
Visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/800 OS
Right eye examination was unremarkable except for peripheral retinal black sunburst lesions
Ischemic macular whitening noted in the left eye
No cherry-red spot, hemorrhage, or peripheral neovascularization present
Fluorescein angiography showed abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula
OCT showed hyperreflective plaques at the level of the INL/OPL
OCT showed temporal macular thinning in the right eye
